method smallestMissingNumber(s: seq<nat>) returns (result: nat)
  requires forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |s| ==> s[i] <= s[j]
  ensures result !in s
  ensures forall k :: 0 <= k < result ==> k in s
{
  result := 0; // Start checking from the smallest non-negative integer, which is 0.
  var index := 0; // This index will iterate through the list `s`.

  while index < |s| && s[index] == result
    invariant 0 <= index <= |s|
    invariant result !in s
    invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < result ==> k in s
  {
    result := result + 1; // Increase result to the next non-negative integer.
    index := index + 1; // Move to the next element in the sorted list.
  }
}

method sumOfFourthPowerOfOddNumbers(n: nat) returns (result: nat)
  ensures 15 * result == n * (2 * n + 1) * (7 + 24 * n * n * n - 12 * n * n - 14 * n)
{
  var sum := 0; // Initialize the sum of fourth powers
  var i := 0; // The count of odd numbers processed
  while i < n
    invariant 0 <= i <= n
    invariant sum == (i * (2 * i - 1) ^ 4) + (i == 0 ? 0 : sumOfFourthPowerOfOddNumbers(i - 1))
  {
    var oddNumber := 2 * i + 1; // Get the i-th odd number
    sum := sum + oddNumber ^ 4; // Add its fourth power to the sum
    i := i + 1; // Move to the next odd number
  }
  result := sum; // Assign the final sum to the result
}

def is_odd(n: int) -> bool:
    return n % 2 == 1


@icontract.ensure(lambda a, result: result == all(is_odd(a[i]) for i in range(len(a)) if is_odd(i)))
def isOddAtIndexOdd(a: List[int]) -> bool:
    # Check every element at an odd index
    for i in range(1, len(a), 2):  # start from index 1 and step by 2
        if not is_odd(a[i]):  # if the number at the odd index is not odd
            return False  # return False immediately
    return True  # All odd indexed numbers are odd

  ensures result[j] == 60
  ensures forall k :: 0 <= k < |a| && k != j ==> result[k] == a[k]

method arraySum(a: seq<int>, b: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
  requires |a| == |b|
  ensures |result| == |a|
  ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |a| ==> a[i] + b[i] == result[i]
{
  result := []; // Initialize an empty sequence to hold the result
  
  var n := |a|; // Length of the input sequences
  
  // We will use a for loop to sum the elements of a and b
  var i := 0; // Initialize index
  while i < n // Iterate while i is less than the length of the arrays
    invariant 0 <= i <= n
    invariant |result| == i // The length of result is equal to i
  {
    result := result + [a[i] + b[i]]; // Append the sum of a[i] and b[i] to result
    i := i + 1; // Increment the index
  }
}
